title: Known differences from the interpreter
summary: The authoritative list is the section 'Known differences that remain' of HANDOFF_2026-10-13.md. At 43b440e it includes: PARSE SOURCE in a compiled routine called by the interpreter is a run-time error (call type unknown); a run-time error inside compiled code shows '*-* Compiled routine' instead of the source line; an untrapped HALT or NOMETHOD raised by a compiled method into an interpreted caller is ignored; CALL ON handlers for conditions inside an INTERPRET string run after the whole string; in a combined library all files share one package; SUPER as a value is unset; REPLY runs the code before the reply on the method's own thread; GUARD WHEN may evaluate its expression more often than interpreted.
invariants: A difference not on the list is a bug: fix it or add it to the list with the reason.
Remove an entry only with a fixture that proves the behaviour now matches.
